head: Fold Clock turns your iPhone into a bedside clock with sleep sounds
dek: Fold Clock fills your iPhone or iPad screen with a large clock and plays sleep sounds such as rain, ocean waves or a fan, with a sleep timer, for $1.99 and nothing to buy inside. It was #87 among paid Utilities apps on the US App Store on 23 November.
details: The sleep timer runs 15 to 90 minutes and fades the sound out over the last 30 seconds; sounds keep playing with the screen locked and pause for calls. There are 16 themes, 8 fonts, your own photo as a background and a red-on-black night mode, plus world clocks, a countdown and timers. It has separate layouts for the folding iPhone Duo and burn-in protection on by default. Made by Bravely Studios, it needs iOS 17 or later.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 17 or later), App Store, $1.99
means: If you want your phone on the nightstand as a clock and white noise machine, this does both for a one-time price.
todo: Turn on the red-on-black night mode if a bright screen keeps you awake.
